paragraphs: A Salmonella outbreak linked to raw oysters is ongoing, with 27 cases across 12 states and 5 hospitalizations reported as of October 19 [1]. A major Class I recall from Kayem Foods Inc. affects more than 1.5 million pounds of ready-to-eat meat and poultry products including hot dogs, bacon, sausage, and turkey breasts due to possible temperature abuse during storage [2][25].

Lidl US is recalling Gelatelli Coffee & Vanilla Gelato with Coffee Sauce & Cookie Pieces (16 FL OZ, UPC 4 0564897 22458, Lot 085261, Best By MAR/26/2028) because it may be contaminated with Listeria monocytogenes [6]. Family Farmstead Dairy is recalling Raw Mild Cheddar Cheese due to potential E. coli O157:H7 contamination [7]. Krasnyi Oktyabr Inc. is recalling STARFISH SEAFOOD PREMIUM COLD SMOKED NORWEGIAN SALMON SLICED after testing positive for Listeria monocytogenes [15].
Pan Pepin Inc. is recalling certain lots of Para Bien Al Grano due to undeclared sesame, which poses a risk to consumers with sesame allergies [9].
